intro.line: Zendikar, Kaldheim, Arcavios. Three worlds, eight fights, and one thin line of oil under all of them.
This is my world, Jace, down to its very bones.
On Zendikar, a party sets out. They are a cleric, a rogue, a warrior and a wizard, and none of them is sure they are the hero.

finale.line: Join me for the dawn of a new age.
The Oriq at Strixhaven are broken, the Doomskar has passed, and Zendikar is quiet again.
Recorded: three worlds, three endings. Something far away has been drawing maps.

villainFinale.line: With one lethal strike, Extus took control of the Oriq and took his first step towards vengeance.
In this version, the Oriq win, and Strixhaven belongs to them.

portrait.card: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

battles.title: The Party
battles.blurb: Zendikar is waking after the Eldrazi, and the vampires of Malakir are not in a welcoming mood. Nahiri has a plan.

scene.line: Zendikar has suffered enough. It is time, at last, for my home to know peace.
Rally to my light, and together we will drive out this darkness!
Modal double-faced cards: a card with two faces. Play it as a spell or as a land, so it is never dead in your hand.

villainScene.line: With the bloodchiefs annihilated in the fight between the free and enthralled, the swamps around Malakir are full of dangerous, young vampires eager to make their marks.

hero.low: The swamp is thick with them...
hero.half: A spell-land can be your land drop in a pinch.

battles.title: The Doomskar
battles.blurb: Kaldheim's realms have crashed together. The warriors of Starnheim stand against Tibalt's raiders.

cards.name: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

scene.line: The realms crashed together, with Bretagard at the center of the calamity.
I have led ten thousand through these mists and never lost the way.
Foretell: pay 2 on an earlier turn to set a card face down in exile, then cast it later for its cheaper foretell cost.

villainScene.line: Arrogant maggot. You won't be so proud when I rip out your tongue and drink from your skull!

hero.half: Foretell early so later turns are free.

battles.title: Pop Quiz
battles.blurb: Strixhaven's colleges argue over everything. Witherbloom and Silverquill are arguing with spells.

scene.line: Step 1: Put the pests in mud. Step 2: Wait.
Death is really just a transfer of energy. Those pests I harvested have the honor of becoming pure magic. What could be more beautiful?
Learn: you may get a Lesson from outside the game, or discard a card to draw a card. It is a cantrip that sometimes finds exactly what you need.

villainScene.line: I avoid violence. It is the last resort of the witless. But if you insist, I'll make an exception for you.
I am very much in the mood to start handing out expulsions.

hero.low: The debate is going their way...
hero.half: Pests are useful when they die.

battles.title: The Elves of Kaldheim
battles.blurb: Nahiri's expedition meets a much bigger monster in Kaldheim's forests.

deck.name: The Elves of the World Tree
deck.label: tribute

scene.line: This is my world, Jace, down to its very bones.
A troll's greatest weapon is its ability to emerge unexpectedly from the landscape.
They have a bigger monster than you. Race, and remove the biggest threats first.

villainScene.line: The arrows of the elvish elite strike as true and deadly as the fangs of the Cosmos Serpent they revere.
I'm no coward, but I'd sooner tangle with a rampaging Torga troll than a hungry lindwurm!

hero.half: Kill the biggest threat before it blocks.

battles.title: Magecraft
battles.blurb: Prismari students want to show off. Kaya has other plans for the campus.

scene.line: No one ever created great art by playing it safe!
Prismari students dance in the tension between passion and perfection.
Magecraft: whenever you cast or copy an instant or sorcery, this triggers. Play cheap spells in the same turn as your mages.

hero.half: Cast a spell while your mage is on the table.

battles.title: Dimir Rogues
battles.blurb: Autumn 2020: a white aggro deck against the Dimir Rogues, who steal your cards.

cards.name: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms

scene.line: Rally to my light, and together we will drive out this darkness!
The landbind ritual connects us to our sacred sites. More importantly, it binds us with every other kor who has visited here, through countless generations.
Beat them down before they steal your answers. Their rogues are fragile.

villainScene.line: The worst part is that you won't even remember how much he's taken from you.
This is a realm of the living. King Narfi's legion is coming to change that.

battles.title: Izzet Dragons
battles.blurb: Spring 2021: Izzet Dragons against a Rakdos pile of berserkers.

scene.line: It would be a crime to withhold my light from the world.
Burn them from the sky.
Hold the dragons until you can afford them. Trade cheap spells while you wait.

villainScene.line: Sven felled the elf with an arrow through the chest, but moments later, the corpse rose with a sneer to fight again.

battles.title: Extus, Oriq Overlord
battles.blurb: Extus has taken the Oriq and wants Strixhaven for himself. Kaya and the deans stand in the way.

card.name: Extus, Oriq Overlord // Awaken the Blood Avatar

scene.line: When your father is Dean Embrose, second best really isn't an option.
Aim higher next time.
Extus gets stronger with every spell. Stop him before the Blood Avatar arrives.

villainScene.line: Join me for the dawn of a new age.
With one lethal strike, Extus took control of the Oriq and took his first step towards vengeance.

hero.half: Kill Extus before the Blood Avatar.

battles.title: Kaldheim Snow Stompy
battles.blurb: Deep in the archive, a green deck that starts with one-drops and ends with a very big troll.

archive.what: A green deck that used snow basics to power Icehide Troll, Sculptor of Winter and Blizzard Brawl.
archive.why: Cheap, efficient snow creatures and a one-mana fight spell made it a fast, consistent attacker.
archive.beat: Kill the early snow creatures before they grow, and chump block the troll until you can remove it.
archive.after: Strixhaven and then Adventures in the Forgotten Realms arrived in Standard in 2021.
